item.title: Harnessing the Power of Shower Thoughts
item.description:
One of the best ways to learn and come up with new ideas is to focus intensely on a problem, then let your mind wander. I’ve enjoyed doing this when problem solving and learning, and recently I’ve been thinking about how weird it is to build trust in your unconscious to do the work for you, especially when it comes to technical work.

Letting your mind focus and letting your mind wander

The first recommendation I have for anyone taking a meta look at learning is Barbara Oakley’s Learning How To Learn. I’ve found it to be a tremendous resource for building better study habits and learning skills, and recommending the course in various threads about learning is easily the majority of my comments on Hacker News.
